validation: 92 targeted Node/NullEngine/real DOM-event cases in 13 suites. No browser or physical-device/GPU performance claim.

boundaries.reason: 연속된 바닥은 지형 도구에서 고쳐 주세요.
연구실 통합 지형은 바닥·천장·연결 통로가 함께 묶여 있어 지형 도구에서 고쳐야 해요.

cave.loading: Dynamic import only for collision-affecting cave documents; empty/unmodified play does not import certificate or rebuild fields.
cave.rebuild: Paused apply transaction only. Complete retained-owner union plus actual transformed near meshes. No per-frame bake or mesh raycasts.
cave.scratch: One reusable body/sight/camera scratch set per commit; 128-object test observes exactly two full camera arrays (final+scratch).
cave.disposal: Restores the specifically owned cached terrain hook even after world terrain changes; clears caches, geometry, source textures and observers.

moonmap.content: Existing version1 JSON with optional removedBaseIds and transform.aspect/frontYaw; old moonmap imports remain compatible.
moonmap.verified: Real UI save after apply; house move/nonuniform aspect, original wall deletion, added stonewall -> existing apply-authored-map CLI -> SHA registry -> collectVillageSiteFiles deployment graph.
moonmap.deployment: Build/publish remains the existing developer pipeline; browser download does not itself publish.

limits: The one integrated cave laboratory shell and continuous outskirts ground remain terrain-tool boundaries with explicit UI reasons.
Animated/skinned/morphing actors remain in the existing NPC/monster editor.
Geometry edits do not author region entrance, quest, signage-text or other scripted interaction coordinates; linked objects show a concise hint.
Existing overlay budget remains 128 simultaneous instances and 8 concurrently held asset definitions.

New ordinary solid props outside caves use conservative transformed mesh bounds; unchanged originals retain exact existing collider parts. Upright moves/scales preserve oriented parts, tilted parts use conservative bounds.
No browser pixel, mobile heat or hardware-FPS validation was performed.
